# aegis

Vendor-agnostic secrets broker and PAM gateway. Scoped API keys per team, any vault, every action logged.

**Homepage:** <https://github.com/gustav0thethird/Aegis>

## Installing

The chart is published as a signed OCI artifact alongside each release. Without
`--version` Helm installs the newest; pin one for a repeatable deployment:

```bash
helm install aegis oci://ghcr.io/gustav0thethird/charts/aegis \
  --namespace aegis --create-namespace \
  --set secret.existingSecret=aegis-credentials \
  --set auth.existingSecret=aegis-auth-json \
  --set migrations.hookProvider=helm
```

Two Secrets must exist in the namespace before installing:

| Secret | Keys | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `secret.existingSecret` | `database-url`, `redis-url`, `admin-password`, optionally `secret-key` | Runtime configuration |
| `auth.existingSecret` | `auth.json` (or `auth.secretKey`) | Vault backend credentials the broker brokers with |

`migrations.hookProvider` defaults to `argocd`; set it to `helm` for plain
`helm install` / `helm upgrade` so the migration Job runs as a pre-install hook.

Verify the chart's signature (keyless, bound to the release workflow):

```bash
cosign verify oci://ghcr.io/gustav0thethird/charts/aegis:<version> \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/gustav0thethird/Aegis/' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Upgrading

```bash
helm upgrade aegis oci://ghcr.io/gustav0thethird/charts/aegis --version <new> --namespace aegis --reuse-values
```

The migration Job runs ahead of the rollout; a failed migration fails the
upgrade before any new pod starts.

| auth.secretKey | string | `"auth.json"` | Key within that Secret that holds the file. |

Keys are database-url, redis-url, admin-password and optionally secret-key; each entry takes `key`, optional `property` and `version` as in ExternalSecret.spec.data[].remoteRef.
